about: Imovane (zopiclone), named by brand only, is supplied every 30 days from February to September 2026, eight supplies of 30 tablets taken nightly, which is far longer than four weeks.
Stilnox (zolpidem) 10 mg nightly is supplied every two weeks from January to April 2026, seven supplies of 14 tablets, in the middle of a 15-month history, which covers about 14 weeks of use.
Two 15-tablet zolpidem courses start 45 days apart with a documented break, so neither course covers more than four weeks.
